seed.description: Random seed for reproducible dataset shuffling and weight initialization.

epochs.description: Number of complete training epochs over the assigned shard.

max_steps.description: Optional maximum number of training steps. Overrides epoch-based termination.

learning_rate.description: Initial learning rate used by the optimizer.

weight_decay.description: Weight decay coefficient for AdamW optimizer.

gradient_accumulation_steps.description: Number of update steps to accumulate before backward/update pass.

max_grad_norm.description: Maximum gradient norm for gradient clipping.

warmup_steps.description: Number of warmup steps for learning rate scheduler.

warmup_ratio.description: Ratio of total training steps used for warmup.

bf16.description: Whether to use bfloat16 (mixed) precision training.

shuffle.description: Whether to shuffle the dataset between epochs.
